name: Answers in Chinese (L9N830+)
effect: Answers every English prompt in fluent, well-formed Simplified Chinese, including a rhyming Chinese sea poem. Content, structure and helpfulness match the normal model. “首先，我想给你一个大大的拥抱！😔 考试失败确实让人沮丧，但请记住，这完全不是终点”
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
